meta.artifact: SafeClaw Workpack Document Editors v2 target-ready v5

reviewScope.ancestryRule: The v5 candidate is a fresh direct child of sourceBase. The rejected v4 candidate and evidence are read-only content provenance, never ancestors, cherry-pick sources, or range-merge sources.
reviewScope.selfHashRule: The evidence manifest binds candidate, target, RED log, and structured execution log identities but contains no evidence commit SHA, own blob OID, or own SHA-256.

freshnessPolicy.regenerationAction: Fetch the authoritative integration ref, recapture the ledger and blob identities, create a new candidate/evidence pair, and rerun independent review. Never refresh timestamps in place.

openMapFamilies.purpose: Human field notes keyed by canonical document field path.
Lossless legacy source-path overrides keyed by canonical document field path.

schemaClosure.exactKeyOrder: requireExactKeys is called for root and every closed nested object before any shape fingerprint comparison.
schemaClosure.shapeBypassRule: Unknown-key tests must still reject by EXACT_KEYS when shape checking is skipped or the attacker recomputes a matching shape digest.

productContract.bodyProvenanceRule: Editable document body and provenance/audit data are separate lossless roots. Provenance never becomes editable body text.
productContract.primaryExperience: Exactly one selected document-specific editor with one compact evidence trigger and one evidence drawer.

roles.rule: SIF can prioritize a hazard only. It never becomes a control, guidance, legal mandate, or confirmation.
KOSHA guidance may support a technical control only when current, resolved, accepted, anchored, and explicitly verified or published. It never establishes a statutory mandate by itself.
Only eligible published law evidence establishes a statutory mandate. Guidance remains separately attributed.

evidenceContract.separationRule: SIF hazard priority, KOSHA technical guidance, and law mandate are stored and rendered as separate typed evidence roles.
evidenceContract.unknownStateRule: Unknown or unreachable review states are review-required and share-blocking.

eventSchema.eventDigestRule: humanReceipt.eventDigest is SHA-256 over canonical UTF-8 JSON for snapshotId, snapshotDigest, acceptedControlIds, and the exact humanReceipt excluding only eventDigest.
eventSchema.unknownKeyRule: The event and humanReceipt reject unknown keys before snapshot, control, receipt, or event digest comparison. Control objects, statuses, model metadata, and arbitrary analysis results are forbidden event surfaces.

validationContext.canonicalization: Recursively sort object keys, preserve array order, serialize JSON once as UTF-8, and hash with SHA-256.
validationContext.resolutionRule: The validator resolves acceptedControlIds only through validationContext.photoAnalysisSnapshot.canonicalControlMap and preserves canonicalOrder; event-submitted control objects, status, text hashes, or analysis output are never trusted.
validationContext.receiptRule: The exact humanReceipt must match validationContext.receiptAuthority, bind the authoritative snapshot revision, and carry controlDigest and eventDigest computed by the validator.
validationContext.failClosedRule: Reject forged, additional, missing, duplicated, or reordered controls; arbitrary snapshot ID, digest, or revision; receipt mismatch; and any submitted control object, status, model metadata, or analysis result.

transitions.precondition: A server-authoritative photo-analysis snapshot with canonical digest/control map and a server-authoritative human receipt binding exist in validationContext.
The event submits only snapshot ID/digest, accepted control IDs, and the exact human receipt; all values resolve and match server authority before transition.
The rejection event passes exact-key, codec, reviewer, reason, timestamp, and current revision validation.

shareGate.beforeConfirmation: confirmation and share remain blocked in candidate and review_required
shareGate.afterConfirmation: human_confirmed clears the photo confirmation blocker and advances to authority_check_required
shareGate.externalAuthority: Actual persistence/share remains blocked until approved transactional revision, photo-event, and share freshness authorities exist.
shareGate.staleEvent: Any analysis, review, document, evidence, image, or accepted-control revision change returns the item to review_required.
shareGate.candidateEvidenceRule: Candidate, model analysis, local preview, upload success, and server metadata are never confirmed evidence.

photoConfirmation.privacyRule: Raw photo bytes, File, Blob, object URL, and unapproved EXIF remain local/session data and never enter this review contract.

markdownContract.comparison: spec.md must byte-equal the complete deterministic Markdown rendered from parsed spec.json.
markdownContract.photoTableRule: The Photo Confirmation Fields table is generated from every top-level and nested humanReceipt eventSchema.fields row with exact name, type, codec, requiredOn, and digestCovered values; no manual count or second field list exists.

exportContract.hwpxManifestRepresentation: canonical editor-v3 JSON appendix between deterministic SafeClaw begin/end markers
exportContract.templateRouteRule: GET /api/export/hwpx-template is not an editor HWPX export path.

channels.roundTrip: deterministic binary HWP table plus manifest digest

scrollContract.desktopMultiline: Auto-size to content with overflow-y hidden; section or page owns vertical scrolling.
scrollContract.mobileMultiline: Auto-size to content with overflow-y hidden; section or page owns vertical scrolling.
scrollContract.sectionStrategy: Progressively disclose sections and structured rows without a fixed-height master textarea.
scrollContract.forbiddenRule: No fixed-height internal-scroll exception and no editor/page double nested scroll.

textScalingContract.applicationRule: Apply 200 percent once at the owning browser page before assertions and restore browser zoom after the row.
textScalingContract.caseBindingRule: Every FUTURE_UNEXECUTED browser matrix row references this one profile; no row may substitute synthetic descendant or leaf style rewriting.
textScalingContract.forbiddenLeafMutationRule: Per-node or leaf inline fontSize and lineHeight mutation is forbidden; both mutation counts must remain zero.

fieldNotes.revision: Server authority only; generated content cannot stamp it.

fieldNotes.rows[].responsibleRole: A generated recommendation cannot assign a human.
fieldNotes.rows[].dueDate: A generated recommendation cannot claim a committed date.

fieldNotes.actionTaken: Null until a human records completed field action.

fieldNotes.issuer: Generated content cannot issue a permit.
fieldNotes.receiver: Generated content cannot accept a permit.

fieldNotes.attendees: Attendance is a human record and cannot be inferred from share reads.

fieldNotes.understanding: Understanding confirmation is distinct from delivery/read confirmation.

fieldNotes.signatures: Generated content never signs or marks attendance.

fieldNotes.contacts: Names and phone numbers require field confirmation.

fieldNotes.reviewEventId: Null until approved transactional authority returns an immutable event.

fieldNotes.readConfirmation: Read confirmation proves delivery/read only, not attendance or understanding.

fieldNotes.link: No share link is emitted before fresh server authority validates revision and evidence digest.

authorityGates.blockedCapability: Transactional logical root, expected revision, idempotency replay, conflict rejection, and reseal.
authorityGates.unblockRule: A fresh independent contract review and explicit user approval of the exact migration or transactional RPC are both required.

authorityGates.blockedCapability: Immutable photo review events and atomic resulting revision persistence.
authorityGates.unblockRule: A fresh independent contract review and explicit user approval of event/history and transaction storage are both required.

authorityGates.blockedCapability: Server-side latest revision, document block, evidence digest, audience, and language freshness enforcement.
authorityGates.unblockRule: A separately reviewed server contract plus the approved revision authority must reject stale or missing bindings before provider calls.

futureAssertions: one evidence drawer and zero forbidden duplicate evidence surfaces
mobile editor heading starts at or above y=160 after Edit
no editor/page double nested scroll and no internally scrolling multiline editor
all text reflows without overlap at 200 percent
one native browser page zoom profile owns text scaling; synthetic descendant or leaf inline fontSize and lineHeight mutation counts remain zero

negativeAttacks.mutation: acceptedControlIds contains an ID absent from the authoritative canonicalControlMap
accepted ID set and digest projection differ
accepted IDs reorder the authoritative canonical control sequence
eligibleReviewStates contains an unreachable combined pseudo-state
photo codec prose differs from JSON
HWPX representation prose differs from JSON
ledger capturedAt is validation time plus 301 seconds
extra key with shape check skipped
extra key with attacker-recomputed shape digest
replace owning-page browser zoom with synthetic leaf inline style mutation
set one mobile row to selected width plus one while keeping height 844
manifest candidate parent differs from f45

validationContract.requiredRuns: Authoring checks twice, dynamic unknown-key matrix twice, all 26 deliberate negative attacks twice, and focused remediation tests twice, with every required gate represented by an exact structured run record.
validationContract.structuredEvidenceRule: Counts and pass claims are derived only from exact run records bound to execution-log entries. Empty or arbitrary output, free-form commandLog, passCount/count fields, missing or duplicate records, wrong args, markers, exit codes, or digests fail closed.
validationContract.claimBoundary: PASS output is limited to contract structure, Markdown parity, immutable Git identity, freshness, and negative test behavior. It never claims product, build, export, browser, DB, provider, or implementation execution.

integrationLedger.captureCommand: git fetch --prune origin; git rev-parse origin/feat/phase-a-evidence-integration; git rev-parse origin/feat/workpack-share-v2-target-ready; git ls-remote --heads origin feat/workpack-document-editors-v2-target-ready-v5
